title: Grateful Dead Live at Rotterdam Civic Hall on 1972-05-11

ai_review.summary: A superb soundboard capture of the legendary 5/11/72 Rotterdam show, highlighted by an epic Dark Star and a soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers a full‑bodied, mostly pristine soundboard mix that lets listeners hear every nuance of what many fans call one of 1972’s peak performances. The second set erupts with a monster ~45‑minute Dark Star, followed by a gorgeous Sugar Mag > Caution > Who Do You Love sequence and a transcendent Morning Dew, all played at a high‑energy, almost feverish level. Minor pitch‑speed quirks can be corrected with EQ, but they do not detract from the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive fan commentary (most 5‑star) praises both the musical performance and the recording; only minor technical notes keep it just short of a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp, full‑bodied mix with excellent instrument separation. Some reviewers note a slight speed/pitch offset (≈‑1 %) and recommend EQ for optimal playback, but no major dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Four‑hour marathon with only one brief break; the first set builds solidly while the second set explodes into an extended Dark Star and a cascade of tight jams, ending on a high‑octane encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his soaring tone, feedback‑laden passages, and leading the long Dark Star jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for tight, soulful bass work that locks in with Jerry, especially during the Dark Star and early jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: References to Keith’s “fire‑breathing demon era” and jazzy keyboard moments during the second set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (the drummer) highlighted as “great” and a driving force through the long improvisations.
